title: Account for contributed property, plant, and equipment

items.concept: Initial recognition of contributed land and building at FV with transfer costs netted against Contribution Revenue; subsequent multi-year depreciation schedule; period-end depreciation adjusting JEs (emphasis); disposal of the contributed building

Number-variant twin — initial recognition of contributed land and building at FV net of transfer costs; subsequent measurement schedule; period-end depreciation adjusting JEs; disposal of contributed building

Period-end adjusting JE emphasis — defer contribution revenue until donor-imposed condition is met; recognize equipment at FV when condition is satisfied at year-end; subsequent depreciation schedule; disposal at end of use
Classification/measurement of Contribution Revenue when recipient pays cash; correct recipient rule for unconditional contributed PPE
